exposure: COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy vs. after pregnancy
COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy vs. no vaccination
outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 97,590 individuals who gave birth between December 14, 2020, and September 30, 2021, in Ontario, Canada
finding: COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy, compared with vaccination after pregnancy and with no vaccination, was not significantly associated with increased risk of adverse peripartum outcomes.
mod_finding: COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy, compared with vaccination after pregnancy and with no vaccination, was not significantly associated with increased risk of adverse peripartum outcomes, including cesarean delivery.
